प्रति 1. प्रति (an indeclinable particle and
prefix to verbs and their derivative nouns; some-
times प्रती in composition), towards, in the direc-
tion of, to, unto, near to; against, in opposition to,
counter; back, back again, again, in return; down
upon, upon, on.

प्रति is also prefixed to nouns not immediately
connected with verbs, to express equality, likeness,
resemblance, or comparison; [cf. प्रति-चक्र,
प्रति-चन्द्र.]
(As a separable preposition with acc. and usu-
ally but not invariably following its substantive),
towards, to, unto, in the direction of (e. g. शब्दम्
प्रति, in the direction of the sound, towards the
place whence the sound came); down upon, upon;
against, in opposition to, counter (e. g. यायाद् रिपुम्
प्रति, he should march against the enemy; पाहि
नस् त्वम् प्रति रीषतः, defend thou us against
the enemy); over against, opposite, contra; in the
presence of, before; in comparison with, in propor-
tion to, on a par with (e. g. त्वं सहस्राणि प्रति,
thou art on a par with, i. e. equivalent to, thousands);
in the vicinity of, near, beside, by, at, on (e. g.
गङ्गाम् प्रति, at or on the Ganges; आयोधनम्
प्रति, on the field of battle); on the side of, in
favour of; (distributively) in each, at or in every,
according to each, severally (e. g. यज्ञम् प्रति, at
every sacrifice; वर्षम् प्रति, every year, annually;
in this sense प्रति is frequently used at the beginning
of adv. comps., cf. प्रति-क्षणम्, प्रति-गृहम्);
about, at the time of, during (e. g. फाल्गुनम्
मासम् प्रति, about the month Phālguna; चिरम्
प्रति, for a long time); in relation to, with refer-
ence to, with regard to (e. g. धर्मम् प्रति,
with regard to justice); concerning; on account of;
according to (e. g. माम् प्रति, according to me,
i. e. in my opinion), in conformity with, in pursuance
[]
of; a little (at the end of a comp., e. g. सूप-
प्रति, a little broth, see Pāṇ.

).
(As a separable preposition, with abl.), on a par
with, on an equality with (also with adverbs ending
with the affix तस्, e. g. नारायणतः प्रति, on an
equality with Nārāyaṇa); in return for, as compen-
sation for (e. g. उक्षा कपोतात् प्रति, an ox in
return for a dove); in the place of, in lieu of,
instead of.
Native lexicographers explain the senses of प्रति
by the following Sanskrit words: प्र-धान, क्षेप,
निश्-चय, व्य्-आवृत्ति, प्र-शस्ति, वि-रोध, सम्-
आधि: [cf. Zend paiti: Old Pers. pati-sh, ‘against:’
Gr. προ-τί, πα-τί, πρός for πρότ, πρόσ-θε-(ν): Lat.
red- as in red-dere, red-ire; re- as in re-ferre;
prœ for prai; por, pol, pos for port in the forms
por-rigo, pol-liceor, pol-lus, pos-sides: Old Slav.
proti: Lith. prësz, ‘against:’ Bohem. proti: Hib.
frith, frioth, as in frithbeart, ‘I object, oppose;’
frithbuille, ‘a back-stroke;’ frithshearc, ‘a return
of love, mutual regard;’ frithcuirim, ‘I oppose,
obstruct;’ frithbharamhuil, ‘a paradox^1.’]
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.
प्रति 2. प्रति, इस्, m., N. of a son of Kuśa.

प्रती प्रती (प्रति-इ; see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P.
प्रत्य्-एति, -एतुम्, to go towards, come towards, go to;
to go back, come back, return; to approach, turn to,
betake one's self to; to fall to the lot or share of;
to reach, attain; to observe, learn exactly, convince
one's self (of the truth of anything); to be con-
vinced, become certain of, give credence to, believe:
Pass. प्रतीयते, to be observed or recognised; to
follow from anything (as a necessary result); to be
proved, turn out to be true: Caus. प्रत्य्-आययति,
-यितुम्, to cause to go towards; to convince (any
one of the truth of anything), produce confidence,
cause to believe; to cause to think of or observe,
bring to mind; to show anything in its true light,
make clear, prove; to cause to recognise or acknow-
ledge: Desid. प्रतीषिषति, to wish or try to
understand.

प्र-त्ति, इस्, f. (for प्र-दत्ति), Ved. giving away,
giving.

प्राति, इस्, f. filling; the span of the thumb and
forefinger.
प्राति प्राति. See under rt. 1. प्रा, p. 652.

प्रतिक प्रतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. प्रति), worth
a Kārṣāpaṇa or sixteen Paṇas of Kowries.

प्रतीक प्रतीक. See under प्रत्य्-अञ्च्,
p. 625, col. 1.

प्रतीक, अस्, आ, अम्, turned towards, directed
towards; adverse, contrary; inverted, reversed, in-
verse, contrary to the natural order or condition;
(अम्), n. an outer or upper part, exterior, surface
(Ved.); outward form or shape, look, appearance
(Ved.; cf. घृत-प्˚, चारु-प्˚, त्वेष-प्˚); an
image, symbol; the face; the front; the mouth;
[]
the first part (of a verse), first word; (अस्), m. a
part, portion, particular point or item; a limb, mem-
ber; N. of a son of Vasu and father of Ogha-vat;
[cf. अनूक, अपाक, अभीक.]
—प्रतीक-वत्, आन्,
m., Ved. ‘having a face or mouth,’ an epithet of
Agni.
—प्रतीकाश्व (˚क-अश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a
prince.
—प्रतीकोपासन (˚क-उप्˚), अम्, n. image
worship, the service of idols.

प्रातिका प्रातिका, f. the China rose, Hibis-
cus Rosa Sinensis (= जवा).

प्रतिकञ्चुक प्रति-कञ्चुक, अस्, m. an ad-
versary.

प्रतिकण्ठम् प्रति-कण्ठम्, ind. singly, se-
verally, one by one (lit. so that each is seized by the
throat).

प्रतिकम्प् प्रति-कम्प्, Caus. P. -कम्प-
यति, -यितुम्, to shake, cause to tremble.

प्रतिकर प्रति-कर, &c. See under प्रति-
कृ, p. 612, col. 1.

प्रति-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, acting against, counter-
acting; (अस्), m. requital, compensation.

प्रतिकार प्रति-कार, &c. See under प्रति-
कृ, p. 612, col. 1.

प्रति-कार, अस्, m. (or प्रती-कार, q. v.), ren-
dering back, requital, reward, retaliation, retribution,
[]
revenge; counteraction, application of an antidote or
remedy, obviating, preventing, remedying, preven-
tion, remedy; opposition; help against, help, allevi-
ation; a kind of treaty or alliance concluded with
the hope that one party will requite the services
rendered by the other.
—प्रतिकार-कर्मन्, अ, n.
the making of amends.
—प्रतिकार-ज्ञ, अस्, आ,
अम्, knowing what remedy should be applied.
—प्र-
तिकार-विधान, अम्, n. the application of a remedy,
medical treatment.

प्रतीकार प्रती-कार, अस्, m. = प्रति-कार,
q. v.

प्रतिकर्कश प्रति-कर्कश, अस्, आ, अम्, equally
hard, of the same hardness.

प्रतिकर्ष प्रति-कर्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कृष्
with प्र), drawing together, aggregation; antici-
pating that which occurs later.

प्रति-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ploughed back again,
twice ploughed; thrust back, repulsed, rejected,
despised; inferior, low, vile; put out of sight,
hidden, concealed.
प्रतिकृष्ट प्रति-कृष्ट. See प्रति-कर्ष.

प्रतिकल्प्य प्रति-कल्प्य. See under प्रति-
कॢप्, p. 612, col. 2.

प्रति-कल्प्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be arranged or
prepared.

प्रतिकश प्रति-कश, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably)
not obeying the whip.

प्रति-काश, अस्, m. (or प्रती-काश, q. v.), reflec-
tion; look, appearance; (at the end of comps.) hav-
ing the appearance of, looking like, similar, resem-
bling, like (e. g. चन्द्र-प्रतिकाश, अस्, आ, अम्,
like the moon).
प्रति-कास, wrongly spelt for प्रति-काश above.

प्रतीकाश प्रती-काश (also wrongly spelt
प्रती-कास)= प्रति-काश, q. v.

प्रतिकाङ्क्ष् प्रति-काङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also
A.) -काङ्क्षति (-ते), -काङ्क्षितुम्, to wish for,
long for.

प्रति-काङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, longing for, desirous
of, desiring.

प्रतिकामम् प्रति-कामम्, ind., Ved. accord-
ing to wish or desire, at will.

प्रति-कामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. contrary to desire,
contrary to taste, disagreeable, distasteful; (इनी), f. a
female rival.

प्रातिकामिन् प्रातिकामिन्, ई, m. (fr. प्रति-
कामम्), a servant, a messenger.

प्रति-काम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being according
to wish or liking.

प्रतिकाय प्रति-काय, अस्, m. an effigy,
image, likeness, picture; the effigy of a man for
archers to practise at; a target, butt, mark.

प्रतिकाश् प्रति-काश्, Intens. -चाकशीति, Ved.
to see, behold.

प्रतिकितव प्रति-कितव, अस्, m. an adver-
sary at play, an opponent in a game

प्रतिकुञ्चित प्रति-कुञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, bent,
curved.

प्रतिकुञ्जर प्रति-कुञ्जर, अस्, m. a hostile
elephant; [cf. प्रति-गज, प्रति-द्विरद, प्रति-
नाग.]

प्रतिकूज् प्रति-कूज्, cl. 1. P. -कूजति, -कू-
जितुम्, to coo or warble in return, answer by an
inarticulate sound.
प्रतिकूप प्रति-कूप, अस्, m. a moat, ditch.

प्रतिकूल प्रति-कूल, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘against
the bank’ (opposed to अनु-कूल, q. v.), against the
stream or current, contrary, adverse, opposed, oppo-
site; cross-grained, cross, inverted, reverse; contradic-
tory; disastrous, inauspicious; disagreeable, unpleasant,
ungracious, perverse, stubborn, contumacious, rebel-
lious; प्रतिकूलेषु स्थित, standing among the re-
fractory, offering opposition (according to Kullūka =
आज्ञा-व्याघात-कारिन्); (अम्, एन), ind. contrary,
contrarily, contrary to nature, in inverted order, in-
versely.
—प्रतिकूल-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, or प्रतिकूल-
कृत्, त्, त्, त्, opposing, offering opposition to (with
gen.).
—प्रतिकूल-तस्, ind. in contradiction or con-
travention to; प्रतिकूलतो वृत्, to be in contradiction
to.
—प्रतिकूल-ता, f. or प्रतिकूल-त्व, अम्, n.
adverseness, opposition, hostility; perverseness, con-
tumacy.
—प्रतिकूल-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्, looking
cross or awry, having an ungracious aspect.
—प्रति-
कूल-दैव-ता, f. hostility of fate.
—प्रतिकूल-प्र-
वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, taking an adverse course; caus-
ing unpleasantness.
—प्रतिकूल-भाषिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
speaking against, contravening, contradicting.
—प्र-
तिकूल-वचन, अम्, n. refractory speech, contradic-
tion; disagreeable speech.
—प्रतिकूल-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, refractory, contumacious.
—प्रतिकूल-वर्तिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, being adverse to, disturbing, troubling.
—प्रतिकूल-वाद, अस्, m. speaking contradictorily,
contradiction.
—प्रतिकूल-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking
contradictorily, contradictory, contradicting, opposing.
—प्रतिकूल-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, being in a state of
opposition, opposing.
—प्रतिकूल-शब्द, अस्, आ, अम्,
having a disagreeable sound, having a discordant note
(Kumāra-s.

).
—प्रतिकूलाचरित (˚ल-आच्˚), अम्,
n. offensive or hostile action, injurious conduct.
—प्र-
तिकूलोक्त (˚ल-उक्˚), अम्, n. contradiction.

प्रतिकूलय, Nom. P. प्रतिकूलयति, -यितुम्,
to oppose, offer opposition to.

प्रतिकृ प्रति-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-
रुते, -कर्तुम्, to do or make (anything as a defence)
against (Ved.); to return, repay, recompense, re-
quite, retaliate (with acc. of the thing, and gen.,
dat., or loc. of the person); to act in opposition to,
counteract (with acc. or gen.); to treat or attend
to (as a physician), cure; to repair, mend, restore:
Caus. A. -कारयते, -यितुम्, to cause to be repeated:
Desid. -चिकीर्षति, to wish to requite, seek to retaliate
or take vengeance upon (with loc. or acc.).

प्रतिकॄ प्रति-कॄ, cl. 6. P. A. -किरति, -ते,
-करितुम्, -करीतुम्, to scatter towards; [cf. प्रति-
स्-कॄ.]

प्रति-करणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be counteracted,
to be prevented, remediable.

प्रति-कर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be requited or re-
turned, to be paid or discharged (as a debt); to be
counteracted or counterworked, to be frustrated; to
be treated or attended (by a physician).

प्रति-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a requiter, recompenser;
an opponent, adversary.

प्रति-कर्मन्, अ, n. requital, retaliation; redress,
remedy; counteraction, counterworking; opposing,
opposition; dress, decoration, toilet, personal embel-
lishment; (अ), ind. at each celebration or perform-
ance; in every work; अ-प्रतिकर्मन्, आ, आ, अ,
(either) whose deeds are unmatched, (or) not offer-
ing opposition; obedient.

प्रति-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, counteracting, obviating,
opposing; अ-प्रतिकारिन्, one who uses no remedies,
one who does not allow himself to be attended by
a physician.

प्रति-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be retaliated or re-
venged; (अम्), n. retribution.

प्रती-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be retaliated upon,
to be made an object of revenge, fit to be revenged;
to be opposed or resisted, opposable, resistible; to
be prevented or remedied.

प्रति-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered back, returned,
repaid, recompensed, requited, retaliated; opposed,
counteracted, remedied; (अम्), n. recompense, re-
quital; resistance, opposition.

प्रति-कृति, इस्, f. resistance, defence; retaliation,
return, revenge; a reflected image, reflection, a
shadow; an effigy, figure, image, statue, picture;
a substitute.

प्रति-कृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be counteracted or
remedied, remediable.

प्रतिकॢप् प्रति-कॢप्, cl. 4. A. -कल्पते,
-कल्पितुम्, -कल्प्तुम्, Ved. to be at the service
of (with acc.); to receive hospitably: Caus. -कल्-
पयति, -यितुम्, to regulate, arrange.

प्रतिकोप प्रति-कोप, अस्, m. anger against
(any one), wrath; vexation.

प्रतिक्रम् प्रति-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति,
-क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to come back, return.
प्रति-क्रम, अस्, m. reversed or inverted order.

प्रति-क्रमण, अम्, n. (Ved.) stepping towards;
(with Buddhists) confessing, making confession.

प्रतिक्रुध् प्रति-क्रुध्, cl. 4. P. -क्रुध्यति,
-क्रोद्धुम्, to be angry with any one (acc.) in
return (Manu
VI. 48
प्रति-क्रोध, अस्, m. anger in return.

प्रतिक्रुष्ट प्रति-क्रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
क्रुश् with प्रति), miserable, poor (said of a kind
of soil).
प्रति-क्रोश, अस्, m., Ved. crying out to, hallooing.

प्रतिक्रूर प्रति-क्रूर, अस्, आ, अम्, cruel or
harsh in return, returning harshness for harshness.

प्रतिक्षणम् प्रति-क्षणम्, ind. at every
moment, every moment, momentarily, every in-
stant; constantly, continually.

प्रतिक्षत्र प्रति-क्षत्र, अस्, m., N. of a
descendant of Atri, author of the hymn Ṛg-veda

; of a son of An-enas; of a son of Kṣatra-vṛddha;
of a son of Śamin.

प्रतिक्षय प्रति-क्षय, अस्, m. a guard, at-
tendant (‘protecting from injury or loss’).

प्रतिक्षि प्रति-क्षि (see rt. 2. क्षि), cl. 2. 6.
P. -क्षेति, -क्षियति, -क्षेतुम्, Ved. to settle near.

प्रतिक्षिप् प्रति-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. -क्षिपति,
-क्षेप्तुम्, to throw or cast into; to push against,
hurt; to revile, ridicule, reject.

प्रति-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown into; turned
away, rejected, dismissed; sent, dispatched; repelled,
[]
opposed, resisted; abused, reviled; calumniated,
falsely accused; (अम्), n. medicine.

प्रति-क्षिप्य, ind. having thrown into, having
thrown.

प्रति-क्षेपण, अम्, n. contradicting, opposing,
controverting, contesting.

प्रतिक्षुत प्रति-क्षुत, अम्, n. sneezing,
wheezing.

प्रतिखुर प्रति-खुर, अस्, m. a particular
wrong position of a child at birth.

प्रतिख्या प्रति-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -ख्या-
तुम्, to see, behold.

प्रति-ख्याति, इस्, f. renown; (also read प्र-
विख्याति.)

प्रतिगज प्रति-गज, अस्, m. a hostile ele-
phant, elephant standing opposite; [cf. प्रति-कुञ्-
जर.]

प्रतिगद् प्रति-गद्, cl. 1. P. -गदति, -गदि-
तुम्, to speak in return, answer.

प्रतिगम् प्रति-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्-
तुम्, to go or advance towards, go to meet; to go
back, return, go home.

प्रति-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, flying backwards and for-
wards, wheeling in flight; lost from the memory.

प्रति-गमन, अम्, n. going back, returning,
return.
प्रतिगर प्रति-गर. See प्रति-गॄ below.

प्रति-गर, अस्, m., Ved. the Adhvaryu's response
to the address of the Hotṛ.

प्रति-गर्जत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, roaring against; mur-
muring against, rebelling; reverberating, echoing.
प्रति-गर्जना, f. roaring against, answering roar.

प्रतिगर्हित प्रति-गर्हित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
गर्ह् with प्रति), blamed (Rām.

; per-
haps wrongly for प्रति गर्हित).

प्रतिगा प्रति-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्,
to go back, return.
प्रतिगात्रम् प्रति-गात्रम्, ind. in every limb.

प्रतिगाह् प्रति-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गा-
हितुम्, -गाढुम्, to penetrate, enter.

प्रतिगिरि प्रति-गिरि, इस्, m. an opposite
mountain; an inferior mountain or anything like a

shelter, asylum, an alms-house; a place where food
&c. is given away; a house, dwelling; a receptacle;
a place of sacrifice, the room or building where the
sacrifice is performed; an assembly.

प्रतिश्रु प्रति-श्रु, cl. 5. P. -शृणोति, -श्रो-
तुम्, to promise (with dat. or gen. of the person and
acc. of the thing).

प्रति-श्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. overhearing, dis-
covering by listening; (अस्), m. promise, agreement,
assent; (according to Mahī-dhara) = प्रति-शब्द.
—प्रतिश्रवान्त (˚व-अन्˚), अस्, m. the expiration
of a promise, i. e. lapse of a promised period.

प्रति-श्रवण, अम्, n. hearkening to, listening
to (with attention and obedience); assenting to,
agreeing, promising; a promise; maintaining; a
particular part of the ear.
—प्रतिश्रवण-पूर्व,
अस्, आ, अम्, preceded by a promise, promised.
प्रति-श्रवस्, आस्, m., N. of a son of Bhīma-sena.

प्रति-श्रुत्, त्, f. an echo, resonance, reverberation;
a promise.

प्रति-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, promised, assented,
agreed, accepted; (अम्), n. a promise, assent; an
engagement.

प्रति-श्रुति, इस्, f., Ved. an echo, repeated sound,
resonance, reverberation.
प्रतिश्रुत्का, f., Ved. = प्रति-श्रुत्.

प्रातिश्रुत्क प्रातिश्रुत्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-
श्रुत्), Ved. existing in the echo.

प्रति-श्रोतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who promises or
assents, a promiser.

प्रतिश्लोकम् प्रति-श्लोकम्, ind. at every
Śloka.

प्रतिषिच्य प्रति-षिच्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. सिच्
with प्रति), Ved. to be besprinkled or moistened.

प्रति-षेक, अस्, m., Ved. besprinkling, moist-
ening.

प्रतिषिध् प्रति-षिध् (-सिध्), cl. 1. P. -षे-
धति, -षेधितुम्, -षेद्धुम्, to keep off, ward
off; to restrain; to hinder; to interdict, prohibit,
forbid, disallow: Caus. -षेधयति, -यितुम्, to
keep off, keep back, ward off; to restrain; to pro-
hibit, interdict.

प्रति-षिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, forbidden, prohibited;
refused, denied, disallowed; contradicted.
—प्रति-
षिद्ध-सेवन, अम्, n. doing what is prohibited.
—प्रतिषिद्ध-सेविन्, ई, इनी, इ, following or doing
what is forbidden.

प्रति-षेद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be warded off,
to be kept back; to be prohibited or forbidden.

प्रति-षेद्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, one who wards
off or keeps back; hindering, a hinderer; prohibiting,
prohibitive, a prohibitor, forbidding; resisting.

प्रति-षेध, अस्, m. keeping or warding off,
keeping back, expulsion (of a disease &c.); forbid-
ding, prohibition; denial, refusal, disallowal; nega-
tion, contradiction; a negative particle; an exception;
enforcing a prohibition, reminding of a prohibition.
—प्रतिषेधाक्षर (˚ध-अक्˚), अम्, n. ‘words
of denial,’ a negative answer.
—प्रतिषेधोक्ति
(˚ध-उक्˚), इस्, f. expression of denial or refusal,
expression of prohibition or contradiction.
—प्रति-
षेधोपमा (˚ध-उप्˚), f. a negative comparison.

प्रति-षेधन, अस्, ई, अम्, keeping or warding
off; (अम्), n. the act of keeping or warding off,
keeping back, expulsion; preventing, prohibiting,
inhibition, refusal, refutation.

प्रति-षेधनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kept back;
to be hindered or prevented; to be prohibited.
प्रति-ष्कष, अस्, m. a whip, a leather thong.

प्रति-ष्कस, अस्, m. a messenger, an emissary,
spy.
प्रति-ष्क, अस्, m. a messenger, an emissary, spy.

प्रतिष्कु प्रति-ष्कु (प्रति-स्कु), cl. 5. P.
-ष्कुनोति, -ष्कोतुम्, to cover in return (with
arrows &c.).

प्रतिष्टब्ध प्रति-ष्टब्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
स्तम्भ् with प्रति), obstructed, impeded, stopped,
withstood.

प्रति-ष्टम्भ, अस्, m. obstruction, impediment,
obstacle, opposition, resistance, hinderance.

प्रतिष्टुति प्रति-ष्टुति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. स्तु with
प्रति), Ved. a song of praise, praise.

प्रति-ष्टोतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who rivals
in praising.

प्रतिष्टुभ् प्रति-ष्टुभ्, cl. 1. A. -ष्टोभते,
-ष्टोभितुम्, Ved. to praise severally, glorify indi-
vidually; (Sāy. = प्रत्येकं स्तु.)

प्रतिष्ठा प्रति-ष्ठा (प्रति-स्था), cl. 1. P. A.
-तिष्ठति, -ते, -ष्ठातुम्, to stand firmly, stand or
rest upon, to be supported; to depend upon; to
stay: Caus. P. -ष्ठापयति, -यितुम्, to place
firmly, to set up, erect; to place; to place with,
consign to (with loc.); to offer.

प्रति-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. standing firmly;
resisting; famous; (अस्), m., N. of the father of
Su-pārśva who was the seventh Arhat of the present
Ava-sarpiṇī; (आ), f. standing still, resting, remaining
in, staying, standing, fixing; a resting-place, site,
ground, base, foundation; a prop, stay; fixity, con-
stitution, strength; the state of rest, quiet, tranquillity,
comfort; the foot (regarded as the basis on which
men and animals stand); a halting-place, dwelling-
place, house, home, residence; the earth; a limit,
boundary; a receptacle; a high or honourable posi-
tion, high authority, pre-eminence; celebrity, fame,
notoriety; the accession (of a king to the throne);
installation, inauguration, the consecration of a monu-
ment or image in honour of a deity or the setting
up of an idol; the performance or institution of any
rites (e. g. the endowment of a temple, portioning a
daughter, completion of a vow, or any ceremonies
for obtaining supernatural and magical powers); ac-
complishment, completion in general; a metre of
four lines of four syllables each; a variety of the
[]
Gāyatrī metre consisting of three lines of eight,
seven, and six syllables respectively; a mystical
designation of the letter आ; N. of one of the
Mātṛs attending upon Skanda; प्रजापतेः प्र-
तिष्ठा or प्रतिष्ठा-सामन्, N. of a Sāman;
(आ), ind., Ved. (perhaps) on the spot.
—प्रतिष्ठा-
काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desirous of a firm basis;
wishing for a home or residence; wishing for emi-
nence or distinction.
—प्रतिष्ठा-तिलक, N. of a
work by Rāma-candra (on the erection of the images
of the twenty-four Jaina Tīrthaṅ-karas).
—प्रति-
ष्ठा-त्व, अम्, n. the being a ground or basis,
being a foundation.
—प्रतिष्ठान्वित (˚ठा-अन्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, possessed of fame, renowned, illustrious,
celebrated.
—प्रतिष्ठा-मयूख, अस्, m., N. of
the ninth section of the Bhāskara.
—प्रतिष्ठा-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a foundation or support.

प्रति-ष्ठातृ, ता, m. epithet of a particular
priest (also called प्रति-प्रस्थातृ, q. v.).

प्रति-ष्ठान, अम्, n. resting or standing firmly,
being firmly stationed; a standing-place, ground,
foundation; the foundation of a city; site, situation;
a leg, foot; N. of a town at the confluence of the
Gaṅgā and Yamunā on the left bank of the Gaṅgā
opposite to Allahabad, the capital of the early kings
of the lunar dynasty; N. of a town on the Go-
dāvarī, the capital of Śāli-vāhana; (औ), m. du. the
constellation Proṣṭha-pada.
प्रति-ष्ठापम्, ind., Ved. having fixed or placed.

प्रति-ष्ठापयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed
or established.

प्रति-ष्ठापयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who erects
or fixes; one who founds, a founder.

प्रति-ष्ठापित, अस्, आ, अम्, set up, erected,
placed, located; fixed, appointed.

प्रति-ष्ठाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed or
located or fixed; to be consigned or made over to
(with loc.).

प्रति-ष्ठि, इस्, f., Ved. resistance; (Sāy.) =
आश्रय.

प्रति-ष्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, set up, erected; esta-
blished, fixed, infixed; comprised, included; placed,
situated; staying; established in life, married; por-
tioned, endowed; consecrated, inaugurated, installed;
completed, finished, effected; applied, applicable;
experienced, conversant with; famous, celebrated,
renowned, illustrious; prized, valued; secured, ac-
quired.
—प्रतिष्ठित-सन्तान, अस्, आ, अम्, one
who has progeny or offspring secured.

प्रति-ष्ठिति, इस्, f., Ved. standing firmly, re-
maining firm or fixed; a station.

प्रतिष्ठासु प्र-तिष्ठासु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing
to remain, &c. See प्र-स्था.

प्रतिष्णात प्रति-ष्णात, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
स्ना), pure.
प्रतिष्णिका, f., see Gaṇa to Pāṇ.

प्रति-स्नात, अस्, आ, अम्, bathed.

प्रतिस्नात प्रति-स्नात, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्ना
with प्रति), bathed, washed; [cf. प्रति-ष्णात.]

प्रतिसंयोद्धृ प्रति-संयोद्धृ, धा, m. an
adversary in war.

प्रतिसंलयन प्रति-संलयन, अम्, n. (fr.
rt. ली with प्रति-सम्), complete absorption.

प्रतिसंवत्सरम् प्रति-संवत्सरम्, ind. every
year, year by year, yearly.

प्रतिसंविद् प्रति-संविद्, त्, f. (fr. rt. विद्
with प्रति-सम्), an accurate understanding of the
particulars of anything.
—प्रतिसंवित्-प्राप्त, अस्,
m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.

प्रति-संवेदक, अस्, आ, अम्, giving detailed
information, informing about the particulars of any-
thing.
प्रति-संवेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, enjoying.

प्रतिसंसर्ग प्रति-संसर्ग, अस्, m. = प्रति-
सर्ग, q. v.

प्रतिसंस्कृ प्रति-संस्-कृ (-सम्-कृ), cl. 8.
P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to mend, repair;
to re-establish, restore; to unite one thing with
another.

प्रतिसंस्थान प्रति-संस्थान, अम्, n. (fr. rt.
स्था with प्रति), settling in, entering into.

प्रतिसंहृ प्रति-सं-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति,
-ते, -हर्तुम्, to draw back, withdraw, drag back; to
place back, replace (an arrow in the quiver); to retract;
to change: Caus. -हारयति, -यितुम्, to retract.

प्रति-संहार, अस्, m. taking back, drawing in,
withdrawing; compression, diminution; comprehen-
sion; retracting; giving up, yielding, resigning.

प्रति-संहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, comprehended, in-
cluded; compressed, reduced in bulk.

प्रति-सञ्जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to with-
draw from, wishing to be freed from.

प्रतिसंहृष् प्रति-सं-हृष्, cl. 4. P. -हृष्-
यति, -हर्षितुम्, to be glad.

प्रतिसङ्काश प्रति-सङ्काश, अस्, m. a similar
appearance, resemblance.

प्रतिसङ्क्रम् प्रति-सङ्-क्रम् (-सम्-क्रम्), cl.
1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go
back again, return; to cease moving on, come to an
end, cease: Caus. -क्रामयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
go back or return.

प्रति-सङ्क्रम, अस्, m. reabsorption, disso-
lution.

प्रतिसङ्क्रुध् प्रति-सङ्-क्रुध् (-सम्-क्रुध्),
cl. 4. P. -क्रुध्यति, -क्रोद्धुम्, to be angry with
(with acc.).

प्रति-सङ्क्रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, angry with, wroth
against.

प्रतिसङ्ख्या 1. प्रति-सङ्-ख्या (-सम्-ख्या),
cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -ख्यातुम्, Ved. to count or reckon
up, count, number.

2. प्रति-सङ्ख्या, f. consciousness.
—प्रतिसङ्-
ख्या-निरोध, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) conscious
cessation of existence; wilful destruction of any
existent thing (?).

प्रतिसङ्गक्षिका प्रति-सङ्गक्षिका, f. a cloak
to keep off the dust (worn by Buddhist mendicants).

प्रतिसङ्गिन् प्रति-सङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt.
सञ्ज् with प्रति), cleaving or clinging to, adhering;
अ-प्रतिसङ्गिन्, not meeting with any obstacle,
irresistible.

प्रतिसङ्ग्रह् प्रति-सङ्-ग्रह् (-सम्-ग्रह्), cl.
9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to re-
ceive, accept.

प्रतिसञ्चर् प्रति-सञ्-चर् (-सम्-चर्), cl. 1.
P. A. -चरति, -ते, -चरितुम्, to come together,
come towards, meet with, meet.

प्रति-सञ्चर, अस्, m. going or moving back-
wards; reabsorption or resolution (back again into
Prakṛti); that into which anything is reabsorbed
or resolved; a place of resort, haunt.

प्रतिसञ्जन् प्रति-सञ्-जन् (-सम्-जन्), cl. 4.
A. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to be born again, to be born
or produced; to spring up, arise, appear.

प्रतिसञ्जीव् प्रति-सञ्-जीव् (-सम्-जीव्), cl. 1.
P. (ep. also A.) -जीवति (-ते), -जीवितुम्, to come to
life again, return to life, revive.

प्रतिसञ्ज्ञा प्रति-सञ्-ज्ञा (-सम्-ज्ञा), cl. 9.
P. A. -जानाति, -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, Ved. to be friendly
towards, to be kindly disposed towards.

प्रतिसदृक्ष प्रति-सदृक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, or
प्रति-सदृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. similar.

प्रतिसन्दिश् प्रति-सन्-दिश् (-सम्-दिश्), cl. 6.
P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to give an errand or commis-
sion in return; to send back a message to (with
gen.); to order, command.

प्रति-सन्देश, अस्, m. a message given in return,
tidings in return, an answer to a message.

प्रतिसन्धा प्रति-सन्-धा (-सम्-धा), cl. 3.
P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put together
again, readjust; to put on, fasten; to aim at, direct
against; to give back, replace, restore; to grasp men-
tally, conceive, comprehend, understand; (A.) to com-
pose one's self; to fit an arrow to the bow-string.
प्रति-संहित, अस्, आ, अम्, aimed at, directed against.

प्रति-सन्धान, अम्, n. putting together again,
joining together; a juncture, the period of transition
between two ages; a remedy; self-command, sup-
pression of feeling; praise, panegyric.

प्रति-सन्धि, इस्, m. reunion; entering into the
womb [cf. भव-प्˚]; a juncture, the period of
transition between two ages.

प्रति-सन्धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be opposed, re-
sistible; अ-प्रतिसन्धेय, irresistible.

प्रतिसान्धानिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्रति-सन्धान),
a bard, a panegyrist.

प्रतिसान्धानिक प्रतिसान्धानिक. See under
प्रति-सन्-धा above.

प्रतिसमन्तम् प्रति-समन्तम्, ind., Ved. on
every side, everywhere.

प्रति-समादिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, enjoined, directed,
ordered.

प्रतिसमाधा प्रति-सम्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. A.
-दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put back again,
replace, affix again; to rearrange, readjust; to re-
dress, remedy; to fit an arrow to the bow-string.
प्रति-समाधान, अम्, n. cure, remedy.

प्रति-समासन, अम्, n. the being a match for,
coping with (with gen.); withstanding, resisting.

प्रतिसमिन्ध् प्रति-सम्-इन्ध्, cl. 7. A. -इन्द्-
धे, -इन्धितुम्, to kindle again, rekindle.

प्रतिसमीक्षण प्रति-समीक्षण, अम्, n. (fr.
rt. ईक्ष् with प्रति-सम्), looking at again, return-
ing a glance.

प्रतिसमुच् प्रति-सम्-उच् (?) , cl. 4. A. -उच्यते,
उचितुम्, Ved. to deserve, be worthy of.

प्रतिसम्बुध् प्रति-सम्-बुध्, cl. 1. P. A., 4.
A. -बोधति, -ते, -बुध्यते, -बोधितुम्, to become
conscious again, recover consciousness.

प्रति-सम्बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, become conscious
again, restored to consciousness, recovered.

प्रतिसम्भू प्रति-सम्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति,
-भवितुम्, to apply or give one's self to (with acc.).

प्रतिसर्ग प्रति-सर्ग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सृज्
with प्रति), continued creation out of primitive
matter; secondary creation or the creation of the
world by the agency of Brahmā and other divinities
regarded as the agents of one supreme being; disso-
lution; the portion of a Purāṇa which treats of the
destruction and renovation of the world.
प्रति-सर्गम्, ind. in every creation.

प्रति-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sent, dispatched; given;
celebrated.
प्रतिसृष्ट प्रति-सृष्ट. See प्रति-सर्ग.

प्रतिसव्य प्रति-सव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, in inverted
order, inverted, reverse.

प्रतिसह् प्रति-सह्, cl. 1. A. -सहते, -सहि-
तुम्, -सोढुम्, to sustain, uphold, support.

प्रतिसामन्त प्रति-सामन्त, अस्, m. ‘an ad-
verse neighbour,’ an enemy, adversary.

प्रतिसायम् प्रति-सायम्, ind. towards even-
ing.

प्रतिसीरा प्रति-सीरा, f. a curtain, a screen
or wall of cloth, an outer tent.

प्रतिसूर्य प्रति-सूर्य, अस्, m. a mock sun,
parhelion; a kind of lizard, a chameleon (which lies
or basks in the sun); (अम्), ind. opposite to the
sun, in the sun.

‘lying or basking in the sun,’ a kind of lizard, a

प्रातिहन्त्र, अम्, n. (fr. प्रति-हन्तृ), the state
or condition of a revenger; vengeance.

प्रातिहर्त्र प्रातिहर्त्र, अम्, n. (fr. प्रति-
हर्तृ, rt. हृ with प्रति), the office or duty of
the Prati-hartṛ, q. v.

प्रातिहारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, containing Prati-hāras (as
a Vedic hymn); (अस्), m. a juggler, conjurer.

प्रातीतिक प्रातीतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रतीति),
existing in the mind or imagination, mental.
प्रातीपिक, अस्, ई, अम्, contrary, reverse, retrograde.

प्रति-तर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -तर्जति, &c., to menace,
threaten, scold at; to challenge.
प्रति-दन्तिन् = प्रति-नाग.
प्रति-नदि, ind. at every stream.
प्रति-श्रित, अम्, n. a protected place, shelter.
प्रति-स्रोतम्, ind. = प्रति-स्रोतस्.
